To show what Spotify, YouTube or another app is playing, with play/pause and skip buttons, the launcher needs Android's "notification access" permission. It uses it only to list media sessions; notification contents are never read or stored.

On phones and tablets the next screen has the switch. On Google TV the screen is usually hidden, so grant it once over adb:

adb shell cmd notification allow_listener com.azura.tvlauncher/.MediaListener

Ask needs an Anthropic API key (console.anthropic.com), entered under Settings › Claude key. Gemini (free) can be chosen under Settings › Ask uses instead.

Ask about what to watch, a recipe, a fact, anything. Press Speak and talk towards the remote (no need to press its microphone button), or type. Gemini answers from memory, so very recent news may be missing.

A Home Assistant row shows lights, switches, scenes and sensors from your own server on the home screen. Enter the server address and a long-lived access token, then choose what to show.
